title: Not Good Enough, but Try Again! The Impact of Improved Rejection Communications on Contributor Retention and Performance in Open Knowledge Collaboration
main_or_robustness: main (regression discontinuity in time around one platform-wide change, plus mediation model)

ineligible_specs.reported_location: Tables 3 and 5 (RD results, base scenario and double data-driven bandwidths)
ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: regression discontinuity in time around a single Stack Overflow-wide change of rejection notices in 2013; one adoption date, no untreated comparison group (footnote 5: no valid DiD control group)
mediation model of contributor performance; not a TWFE DiD

eligible_reason: Not staggered. The treatment is a single platform-wide change to Stack Overflow rejection notices in 2013, estimated with a regression discontinuity in time design (Tables 3, 5) and a mediation model. The authors state that a DiD control group is not available (footnote 5).
design_notes: Daily retention rate of initially rejected contributors before/after the change; RDiT with data-driven bandwidths, plus a mediation model for performance. Regression inventory empty because the archive holds no code.
data_files_note: The archive contains only a .docx with an external Dropbox link to replication_package_MS-INS-21-02720.zip; no code or data in the archive (not downloaded). Underlying data are public Stack Overflow data dumps.
data_provenance_note: Package hosted externally (Dropbox link); nothing shipped in the INFORMS archive.
software_notes: No code in archive; software unknown
screener_notes: Published text confirms RDiT plus mediation. Not a near miss: single treatment date and no comparison group.
